narrative.northStar: The Seleção's six-star destiny — expressed in verde, amarelo, and azul at full typographic weight.
narrative.overview: Brazilian national palette replaces purple/magenta. Montserrat pushed to 900 for display. 11 sections unchanged in structure, transformed in surface. Azul dark sections replace black. Amarelo CTAs with azul text.
keyCharacteristics: Brazilian national palette (verde / amarelo / azul) — no other hues
Montserrat wght 900 display — full variable font engagement
Type scale ratio 1.25 (up from 1.122) — committed expressive tier
Amarelo CTAs on azul text — 13:1 AAA contrast, unmistakably Brazilian
Azul replaces black for dark sections
Verde restricted to large text and decorative use (3.1:1 limit honored)
rules: Verde on body-size text is forbidden — large text and decorative only
Every image with overlaid text requires a verde/azul gradient scrim
CTAs are uppercase, amarelo background, azul text — no exceptions
Mixed-case headings ≥3 words; uppercase eyebrows ≤3 words
Section padding: 64px desktop / 48px tablet / 32px mobile (balanced, hard floor)
dos: Use Montserrat 900 for hero headlines — the font earns it
Use azul for dark section backgrounds (warmer than black, Brazilian)
Use amarelo sparingly — it earns its power through restraint
Use verde as a left-border accent on cards
Give football photography full width — min 480px card images, full-bleed hero
donts: Don't use verde as body text color
Don't put amarelo text on white backgrounds (fails contrast)
Don't add a second hue outside the three national colors
Don't use more than one CTA per section
